basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One ANRF Project Assistant post is open in the Department of Applied Geophysics at the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad under an ANRF-ECRG project on natural hydrogen hotspot mapping. The position is purely temporary for 6 months and may be extendable until 1 year depending upon availability of fund. The fellowship is Rs. 27,000 per month plus HRA as per institute norms when hostel accommodation is not available. content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Natural Hydrogen hotspots mapping and characterization in India through the lens of geoscientific data, and artificial intelligence technology
6 months, may be extendable until 1 year depending upon availability of fund
Rs. 27,000/- per month plus HRA as per the institute norms in case hostel accommodation is not available
As per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST-ANRF for JRF recruitment

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Bachelor's degree in science / 3years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Desirable qualification: Candidates with some prior experience in geophysical data acquisition, field survey, and inversion for subsurface resource modelling will be given preference. Age and relaxation: As per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST-ANRF for JRF recruitment. The notice does not print a numerical age limit or a cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship: Rs. 27,000/- per month. HRA is paid on top of this as per the institute norms, but only in case hostel accommodation is not available. The position is purely temporary. It is sanctioned for a period of 6 months and may be extendable until 1 year depending upon availability of fund.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Contribute primarily to natural hydrogen mapping with integration of gravity and magnetic datasets. Support in field survey for sampling. Experimental analysis and data interpretation. Report/article writing. Any other work assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Combine your updated CV and testimonials into a single PDF. Email the PDF to the PI at both addresses: [email protected] and [email protected] . Write this subject line: "Application for the position of ANRF Project Assistant under SRDP/1197/G". Send the email by 13 November 2026 (Friday). Documents named in the notice: Updated CV Testimonials

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be communicated through email tentatively by 16 November 2026 to appear for an online/offline interview. All candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 ANRF Project Assistant post under the ANRF-ECRG project in the Department of Applied Geophysics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to the PI by 13 November 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ANRF Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in science / 3years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Candidates with prior experience in geophysical data acquisition, field survey and inversion for subsurface resource modelling will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit and relaxation are as per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST-ANRF for JRF recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send your updated CV and testimonials as a single PDF to both [email protected] and [email protected] by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line should be "Application for the position of ANRF Project Assistant under SRDP/1197/G".

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ANRF Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and the requirement of the project. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email tentatively by 16 November 2026 to appear for an online/offline interview, and no TA/DA will be paid to attend it.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, sanctioned for 6 months, and may be extendable until 1 year depending upon availability of fund.
